								|2026-09-08|Code ▽|Embed ▽|No License11Copy and paste the snippet below into your HTML.Princess Mochi has a jetpack, two pigtails that never quite keep up with her, and a whole town's worth of mochi to carry home before dark.UFOs always flank her in single file, then dive straight into her.[8x8]The pigeons mean well. They fan in, arrange themselves into a very tidy little ring, and shoot at her anyway.[8x8]Fishcakes aren't meanies exactly, they're just happily wiggling through their little ribbon dance, unfortunately right in her way.[8x8]The mech means it rather more. And somewhere past the second town something enormous is waiting, though she'd rather not think about that part just yet.[16x16]Mochi is the whole point.[16x16]Pink mochi makes her gun quicker and her reach longer.  These appear whenever she terminates an enemy fool that gets in her way.[16x16]Cream mochi makes her light on her feet. These appear when she obliterates an entire wave of pigeons, UFOs, or fishcakes.[16x16]Matcha mochi, her favorite, buys hearts, and hearts are the one thing nobody can take back off her; clip a tree or a road sign and everything else goes bouncing merrily away down the road behind you. name: Beeventure!
author: Zandor
description:
Beeventure!Zandor•2026-08-27*2026-08-27 00:26*•BBS>PICO-8>CartridgesSubscribe to this Thread(Receive email notifications)Pin To ProfilepewubosuboCart File|Forum Post|More cartridgesbyZandorMore Cartridges[View All]pewubosubobyZandorCart#pewubosubo-0

								|2026-08-27|Code ▽|Embed ▽|License:CC4-BY-NC-SA3Copy and paste the snippet below into your HTML.This is my first PICO-8 game! I had a lot of fun making it and I hope you like playing it. Let me know what you think!BEEVENTUREYou're a bee with one year to live. Gather pollen, turn it intohoney, and store up enough to survive the winter.THE GOALCollect 20 honey before winter ends. Each season runs 2.5 minutes,so a full year is about ten minutes. The world changes with theseasons -- the palette shifts, the flowers change, and it snows inwinter.CONTROLS⬅️ ➡️   move❎      hold to fly, let go to drop🅾️      call your helper bees back to you(also revives you when you die)HOW IT WORKSLand on a flower to collect pollen -- you can carry 4 to start.Fly home and land on the hive to deposit it.The honeycomb holds 16 pollen. Every time you fill it you get:+4 honey+1 helper bee (up to 4)+1 health, if you're hurtSo 20 honey means filling the comb five times. Flowers regrow aftera while, so you never run the world dry.HELPER BEESYour helper bees follow you and pick fights with the flies. Each onealso raises how much pollen you can carry, up to 8 with a full crew.They're fragile -- three hits and they're gone -- and when one diesyour carrying capacity drops with it. Press 🅾️ to pull them out of afight before they get killed, and bring them back to the hive to healthem up.WATCH OUTFlies cost you a heart on contact, and you only have four. Run out andyou'll wake up back at the start with full health -- but you'll dropevery scrap of pollen you were carrying.Press 🅾️ on the title screen for in-game help.casualarcadeaction3

								|2026-09-08|Code ▽|Embed ▽|License:CC4-BY-NC-SA6Copy and paste the snippet below into your HTML.You're a frog in a generated maze. Eat every pip to clear it.Two kinds of pip[8x8]Normal pipsare everywhere. You'll have plenty.[8x8]Rubiesonly appear when a frenzied ghost is within three tiles of you.While one is that close, every pip you eat turns red. Get far enough awayand they turn normal again.Play it safe and you'll finish the maze with a pile of normal pips andnothing worth spending them on.To get rich, you have to let the ghostsget close.Ghosts[8x8][8x8][8x8][8x8]Ghosts wander the maze looking for frenzy pills. They avoid you, untilthey eat one.A wandering ghost is food. Run into it and you eat it for pips.But when a ghost eats a frenzy pill it turnsredand hunts you forabout ten seconds.If it catches you, you lose90%of your pips, both colours. It alsoeats your auto-frogs.Frenzy pills[8x8]Frenzy pills are what set the ghosts off. One flashes for a second beforeappearing, with a strange little sound.You can eat one yourself for 10 normal pips and 5 rubies. Doing so alsocalms every frenzied ghost in the maze.Fruit[8x8][8x8][8x8]Fruit puffs in away from you and hops around. 								|2026-08-21|Code ▽|Embed ▽|License:CC4-BY-NC-SA5Copy and paste the snippet below into your HTML.I've been playing around with PICO-8 to explore what it might be like to use for computer game art and philosophy. Here's my latest:NHS ManagerA tiny art-game about public healthcare in modern Britain."This was the first time I addressed a contemporary political issue in an art-game. I thought it would be interesting to make a simple simulator about being a manager of an NHS hospital. I used to play games like Theme Hospital and Sim City. They always had a sharp satirical edge, something that was lost as the genre developed in the 2000s. Given the pressures on the NHS today, I wanted to go back to that. Like many people in Britain, I've received fantastic care from the NHS. But there's also times when I've been let down. And I've lived through all the rounds of 'reforms'. I even worked as a healthcare assistant for a bit, back at the Norfolk and Norwich Hospital when I was first swapping PICO-8 carts. This game is both a love letter to and a playful satire of an institution that we need more than ever."-- James LaGrandeIf you enjoyed this game, please considerdonating to the NHSor, better yet, writing to your MP in support.ControlsArrow keys to select(X) and (Z) to confirmsimhospitalnhssimulatorartart-game5
